name: Wanderer
title: Eons Adrift
description: A wayfaring figure whose identity is a mystery. He dresses like a mountain ascetic, but he certainly does not act the part.

skills.name: Yuuban Meigen
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 3 attacks using wind blades, dealing Anemo DMG.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina, gathers a build up of high wind pressure, and deals AoE Anemo DMG after a short casting time.

Plunging Attack
Calling upon the power of Anemo, the Wanderer plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents in his path. Deals AoE Anemo DMG upon impact with the ground.

skills.name: Hanega: Song of the Wind
skills.description:
Concentrates the power of the winds to break free from the shackles of the earth, dealing AoE Anemo DMG before leaping into the air and entering the Windfavored state.

Windfavored
The Wanderer cannot perform Plunging Attacks in this state. When he uses Normal and Charged Attacks, they will be converted into Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai respectively; the DMG they deal and their AoE will be increased, and their DMG will be considered Normal and Charged Attack DMG respectively. Kuugo: Toufukai will not consume Stamina.
The Wanderer will hover persistently during this time. While this state is active, the Wanderer's movements gain the following properties:
·Persistently consumes Kuugoryoku Points to maintain this hovering state.
·When sprinting, additional Kuugoryoku Points will be consumed for the Wanderer to accelerate mid-air. Holding sprint will cause persistent Kuugoryoku Point consumption to maintain speed. This effect will replace his default sprint.
·Jumping expends extra Kuugoryoku Points to increase hovering height. Holding jump will cause persistent Kuugoryoku Point consumption to keep increasing hovering height.

Running out of Kuugoryoku Points will end the Windfavored state.
A second cast during the duration of Windfavored will also end it.
skills.info: "The world dances in a weightless whirl, presenting a secret that can only be found in the flowers."

skills.name: Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays
skills.description:
Compresses the atmosphere into a singular vacuum that grinds all troubles away, dealing multiple instances of AoE Anemo DMG.
If the character is in the Windfavored state due to the skill "Hanega: Song of the Wind," Windfavored state will end after casting.
skills.info: "Bright be the narrowed gaze of the sky, casting its sight on dreams both past and present, like radiance washing over dust on the winds."

passives.name: Jade-Claimed Flower
passives.description:
If Hanega: Song of the Wind comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro when it is unleashed, this instance of the Windfavored state will obtain buffs according to the contacted element(s):
·Hydro: Kuugoryoku Point cap increases by 20.
·Pyro: ATK increases by 30%.
·Cryo: CRIT Rate increases by 20%.
·Electro: When Normal and Charged Attacks hit an opponent, 0.8 Energy will be restored. Energy can be restored this way once every 0.2s.

You can have up to 2 different kinds of these buffs simultaneously.

passives.name: Gales of Reverie
passives.description:
When the Wanderer hits opponents with Kuugo: Fushoudan or Kuugo: Toufukai in his Windfavored state, he has a 16% chance to obtain the Descent effect: The next time the Wanderer accelerates in mid-air while in this instance of the Windfavored state, this effect will be removed, this acceleration instance will not consume any Kuugoryoku Points, and he will fire off 4 wind arrows that deal 35% of his ATK as Anemo DMG each.
For each Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai that does not produce this effect, the next attack of those types will have a 12% increased chance of producing it. The calculation of the effect production is done once every 0.1s.

passives.name: Strum the Swirling Winds
passives.description: Mora expended when ascending Bows and Catalysts is decreased by 50%.

constellations.name: Shoban: Ostentatious Plumage
constellations.description:
When in the Windfavored state, the Attack SPD of the Wanderer's Kuugo: Fushoudan and Kuugo: Toufukai is increased by 10%.
Additionally, the wind arrows fired by the Ascension Talent "Gales of Reverie" will deal an additional 25% of his ATK as DMG. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Gales of Reverie."

constellations.name: Niban: Isle Amidst White Waves
constellations.description:
When in the Windfavored state, Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays will see its DMG increased by 4% per point of difference between the max amount of Kuugoryoku Points contrasted with Kuugoryoku's present capacity when using this skill.
Through this method, you can increase Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays's DMG by a maximum of 200%.

constellations.name: Sanban: Moonflower Kusemai
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Kyougen: Five Ceremonial Plays by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Yonban: Set Adrift into Spring
constellations.description:
When casting Hanega: Song of the Wind, should the Ascension Talent "Jade-Claimed Flower" be triggered, the character will gain buffs in correspondence to the contacted Elemental Type(s), and also obtain a random untriggered buff. A maximum of 3 such corresponding elemental buffs can exist simultaneously.
You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Jade-Claimed Flower."

constellations.name: Matsuban: Ancient Illuminator From Abroad
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Hanega: Song of the Wind by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Shugen: The Curtains' Melancholic Sway
constellations.description:
When the Wanderer actively hits an opponent with Kuugo: Fushoudan while in the Windfavored state, the following effects will occur:
·Deals an additional instance of Kuugo: Fushoudan at the position hit, dealing 40% of the attack's original DMG. This DMG will be considered Normal Attack DMG.
·When the Wanderer falls below 40 Kuugoryoku Points, restores 4 Points to him. Kuugoryoku Points can be restored in this manner once every 0.2s. This restoration can occur up to 5 times within one Windfavored duration.

outfits.name: A Wrathful Void
outfits.description: {REALNAME[ID(1)]}'s outfit. An ascetic's garb and hat can provide the wanderer some shelter from the rain, but they can do nothing to quell the winds and storms raging within.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: You want me to introduce myself? I've gone by many names and titles during my journey. Although each one is more eminent than any ordinary mortal could imagine, they're all just water under the bridge to me now.\nCall me whatever you like. Go ahead, let me see what you can come up with. Don't disappoint me.

voices.title: Chat: The Wind
voices.text: There's no such thing as pure freedom in this world. Even the wind cannot blow on forever.

voices.title: Chat: Manner of Speech
voices.text: You think I've got a sharp tongue? I just tell it like it is. If someone can't handle it, maybe that's their problem.

voices.title: Chat: Exchanging Pleasantries
voices.text: There's no need to exchange pleasantries. It's rather pathetic to force a conversation just to occupy silence.

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: You want to use my hat as an umbrella? Hmph, the audacity to even make that request...

voices.title: After the Rain
voices.text: You're so happy just to see the sun again? How childish.

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: Huh. How irritating.

voices.title: When It Snows
voices.text: Fundamentally speaking, there's little difference between snow and rain, yet people lavish praise only upon the former... Fate can be truly arbitrary.

voices.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voices.text: A simple breeze like this... Even you can conjure it, right?

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: "Rise and shine, sleepyhead, the sun's already in your eyes!" ...Haha, don't tell me you actually thought I'd wake you up like that?

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: I have no need for food. Save me the trouble and take care of yourself and that small thing floating next to you.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: Finally, another boring day is drawing to a close.

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: What, can't fall asleep with me around? Hehe.

voices.title: #About {REALNAME[ID(1)]}: Puppet
voices.text: A puppet consumed by a raging fire will leave behind ashes. As for what will emerge from them...

voices.title: #About {REALNAME[ID(1)]}: Heart
voices.text: I'll leave that kind of thing to fate. Obsessing over something that's destined to be ever out of one's reach is just a waste of time. I have more important things to attend to at the moment.

voices.title: About Us: Rivals
voices.text: So, you're still stewing over our run-ins from before? Huh. Well, what are you going to do about it? Take your time. I'm in no hurry.

voices.title: About Us: Collaborators
voices.text: I'll never be one of the good guys. I'm just here to pay my dues after what you've done for me.\nBut what about you? Shouldn't you come up with some excuse for our meetings? If one of your friends mistakes you for collaborating with the enemy, you're on your own.

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: Although the idea of "divine favor" makes me a little ill, I'm not going to be picky about a new source of power. You think there's some kind of meaning behind the element of Anemo? Hah, why did that thought even occur to you? The gods aren't guided by any kind of rationality or moral compass. Haven't I shown that to you already?

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: I've got nothing. Ask me anything if you want. If a question is interesting enough, I may give you an answer.

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: Look. The birds are showing off their plumage, the squirrels are busy hoarding food, and humans are laboring for their livelihoods. Truly, simple animals don't need anything complicated to be fulfilled.

voices.title: About Lesser Lord Kusanali
voices.text: While I still had value as a pawn, she might have had other reasons to keep me alive. It's certainly possible that it was because she's wise or benevolent, or happened to see a hint of loneliness within me... You think I'm trying to think the worst of her? Hah, did you really expect anything else? In case you've forgotten, I'm no saint.

voices.title: About the Raiden Shogun
voices.text: She completely neglected her own creation, and to add insult to injury, she said it was because she "couldn't bring herself to intervene" in my fate...

voices.title: About the Tsaritsa
voices.text: Everyone praises her for her kindness and benevolence, but they forget that love is also a form of sin. What if she's just trying to compensate for something?

voices.title: About The Jester
voices.text: The Jester is a survivor of Khaenri'ah. Besides that singular fact, I know very little about him, and never had any kind of close association with him. He seems to want something from me, though. In the past, he assigned to me many important tasks, including a number of trips to the Abyss.

voices.title: About The Captain
voices.text: "The ever-righteous Captain," "the brave and fearless Captain," "the nigh-invincible Captain"... Even my mechanical ears demand maintenance after listening to so many compliments from the members of the Fatui. Don't you think that possessing absolute righteousness is actually a latent danger? And that's without taking his great personal strength into account.

voices.title: About The Doctor
voices.text: It's a pity that Lesser Lord Kusanali already forced him to erase so many of his segments. The joy I would have derived from slicing them apart one by one...

voices.title: About Damselette
voices.text: Let me ask: what should you do if you were to encounter a "damsel" who is oblivious and innocent at any given time, and unconcerned and unfeeling in any given situation? If it were me, I could at least challenge her to a fight. But if it were you... with your conscience, I would stay away from her.

voices.title: About The Knave
voices.text: A wolf in sheep's clothing. To exert a higher level of control over people, she puts on a graceful and cordial front. Most of those who have seen her true, crazy self... have gone poof.

voices.title: About The Rooster
voices.text: Only someone as dense as Childe would think The Rooster is looking after him and his family out of the goodness of his heart. Although the mayor has indeed done a number of things for their benefit, anyone with a brain would be able to tell that the underlying meaning is "your entire family is in my hands."

voices.title: About Marionette
voices.text: She has a terrible personality and cares for nothing outside of her own research. But even with that amount of dedication, she still produced a copious amount of garbage, and could only secure a ranking that's still one whole place beneath my own. How pitiful.

voices.title: About Regrator
voices.text: Oh, the ninth-ranked guy. He's obsessed with the idea of "fair exchange," to the point of wanting to overthrow the natural imbalance between gods and humans. But, I guess it's just how ordinary mortals are like — it's easy for them to come up with pointless delusions. Honestly, it's nothing worth writing home about, just like how there's also nothing impressive about his abilities or choice of partner. Hmph. Anyone who chooses to work closely with The Doctor is sure to meet a nasty end.

voices.title: About Childe
voices.text: He's simple of mind and not that strong of body. Naming him to the lowest-ranked seat lowered the Harbingers' collective prestige. Thankfully, I'm no longer part of that group.

voices.title: About The Fair Lady
voices.text: Nothing remained in her ashes. I have no interest in those who have lost their future.

voices.title: About Yae Miko
voices.text: A smooth-talking youkai. Though she pretends to care about humans to gain the favor of her god, all she seeks are entertaining ways to pass her time.

voices.title: About Kaedehara Kazuha
voices.text: You speak of the descendant of the Kaedehara clan? Then isn't he... Wait, he also possesses an Anemo Vision? ...And even managed to take on the Raiden Shogun's Musou no Hitotachi? Hehe... Ahahahaha!

voices.title: About Sethos
voices.text: What makes you think I know him? The fact that he's always following me around and asking for a closer look at my hat? We've barely spoken before. The first time we met, he came up and asked me if I was Hat Guy... Last time I checked, judging someone by their appearance is superficial. Hmph, somehow, everyone knows the name "Hat Guy" now...

voices.title: About Durin
voices.text: When he first came out of that book, he had such a long list of questions. I never imagined becoming human would make him even more curious. His letters are so long — and his handwriting is so crooked, I can barely make it out.\nYou can help explain things to him if you've got time, just to make sure he doesn't get off track.

voices.title: #More About {REALNAME[ID(1)]}: I
voices.text: You want to learn more about me? How ridiculous. Don't you know that's only asking for trouble?

voices.title: #More About {REALNAME[ID(1)]}: II
voices.text: Oh, I'm well aware that many, many people will want to seek me out and settle the grudges they've built against me in my past life. Fine by me — come one, come all, I say. As a matter of fact, I'm somewhat looking forward to it.

voices.title: #More About {REALNAME[ID(1)]}: III
voices.text: I once thought that deification would allow me to get rid of all of my pointless emotions, but I've since abandoned that view. Anger, whether it be from others or myself, is too convenient and useful as a tool.\nHow can some people just never become angry? I find that impossible to even imagine. Do they just not have a single mean bone in their bodies?

voices.title: #More About {REALNAME[ID(1)]}: IV
voices.text: When I entered Irminsul, there was only one thought in my mind: I wish I'd never been born at all.\nIrminsul responded to my wish, but didn't bring me the outcome I desired. The fate of this world hasn't changed a single bit when it comes to playing cruel tricks on its prisoners.

voices.title: #More About {REALNAME[ID(1)]}: V
voices.text: You and I have crossed paths in the past, but our journeys will eventually diverge. Who knows what will happen next? Let's just wait and see.

voices.title: #{REALNAME[ID(1)]}'s Hobbies
voices.text: Hobbies? Those are for idle bodies who have the free time to think about such things. Do I look like I have any interest in distractions?

voices.title: #{REALNAME[ID(1)]}'s Troubles
voices.text: I'm trying to figure out a way to get rid of you so I can go commit atrocities. ...Wait, did you think I was being serious?

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: Do you have some tea? The more bitter, the better. It leaves the most fascinating aftertaste.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: I'm no fan of Dango, or any other sticky sweets that make me feel like my teeth are fusing together. Keep them to yourself.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: It's okay. Guess this is one of the few things you're good at.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: Not bad. You actually made something edible.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: You wanna poison me? Are you so dumb as to have forgotten that I'm not human?

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Give me your hand. Heh, there's no need to be nervous. I'm just taking you to a vantage point.\nHow is it? The scenery here should be quite breathtaking. There's no need to thank me — I see little point in it.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: ...I can see the great deal of effort you put forth.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: The wind is blowing this way... What did you do?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: You aren't worried about making me more powerful? ...Alright.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: Although I can be of help to you, seeing me as an ally is still a dangerous endeavor. I hope you understand what you're doing. If you still insist on continuing down this path, then let me lead the way.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: The wind rises!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Behold!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Squall and fury!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Unsightly insects!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Wretched vermin!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: Cry louder!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: IV
voices.text: Bow your head!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: V
voices.text: Know your place!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: VI
voices.text: You dare to gaze upon me!?

voices.title: Sprint Start: I
voices.text: Surge forth!

voices.title: Sprint Start: II
voices.text: Upon the gale!

voices.title: Sprint Start: III
voices.text: ...Too slow.

voices.title: Sprint Start: IV
voices.text: Quit following me!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: Unnecessary.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Hah, you even want this?

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: Take it and have fun.

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: I'm used to this.

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Nothing worth mentioning.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Why are you even here?

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Worthless as expected.

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: Falling... into the abyss...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Everything... was futile...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: The price... for my sins...

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: That's far enough.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: II
voices.text: ...How amusing.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: III
voices.text: ...You're dead.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: IV
voices.text: I'll have you beg for mercy.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: V
voices.text: Prepare yourself for punishment.

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Huh... What do you want from me?

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: This had better be important.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: Are you sure it has to be me? ...Fine, let's get this over with.
